rules: gold = slugs that must be retrieved (most important first; notes pages count as the same slug); sections = where the answer is (kind post|notes, anchor "" = the intro chunk before the first heading); must = facts a good answer contains; covered=false means the right answer says the blog does not cover it and names the gold posts as closest. teardown-lab (AO-073) and unlisted pages are never gold.

corpus_notes.size: 82 docs (71 listed posts incl. live AO-073 + 11 notes pages), 986 chunks (898 without AO-073), 903k chars; AO-073 alone is 106k chars / 88 chunks and is flagged live in manifest.live
corpus_notes.notes_pages: 11 notes pages share the slug of their post, carry no preview/topic, and repeat the post at 3-10x the length; some facts live ONLY in notes (e.g. the Opera Game name in touch-move, Megabonk take-off speeds). Fusion must dedupe post+notes per slug but keep the notes text when budget allows.
corpus_notes.claude_voiced: doc.voice == "claude" (e.g. crimson-coil, earthlight, context-window, touch-move, bad-very-bad, the-small-one-harness, echo-the-borrowed-voice); answers must credit Claude for those
corpus_notes.text_gaps: inline code spans and tables are stripped from chunk text (e.g. renting-a-gpu: "The other is the switch in ComfyUI"; blackwater-2: "The missing line was ."; inscryption: "If the game folder has , the code"); the full-post context should come from a source that keeps them or the model will see holes
corpus_notes.anchors: anchor "" is the intro chunk before the first heading; several chunks can share one anchor; every post has a "short" chunk = the preview text (title-ish summary + verdict + points)
